extra-b61361936486.zh-Hans:
为国际短剧受众创作一支30秒、16:9的高端真人吸血鬼爱情预告片。使用Image 1作为两位主角的外貌参考，使用Image 2作为城堡环境参考。在每一个镜头中始终保持两人的身份一致，采用超写实真人电影摄影、电影级灯光、自然皮肤质感和富有情感表现力的表演。

故事：一位好奇的年轻女子意外闯入一座被遗忘城堡的禁地侧翼，在那里唤醒了沉睡数百年的古老吸血鬼贵族。他一见到她，就感知到她血管中流淌着古老战争的血脉。他没有杀她，反而危险地被她迷住。他的执念立刻升级为想要将她留在身边的占有欲。她被他的强大气场吓到，却拒绝完全屈服，以安静的勇气迎上他的支配。

风格：高端ReelShort / DramaBox吸血鬼爱情。黑暗浪漫、情感强烈、命运羁绊、神秘、优雅且诱人但不露骨。通过眼神交流、台词之间的沉默、克制的情感和强烈的化学反应来营造不断升级的浪漫张力。节奏应像一部爆红国际剧集的开篇一集，并以令人震惊的悬念结尾。无血腥，无廉价恐怖，无万圣节服装，无怪物，无现代街头服饰。

城堡仅由透过高耸彩绘玻璃窗洒下的月光、闪烁的烛光、壁炉、飘动的薄雾、古老吊灯、大理石地面、天鹅绒窗帘、高耸书架、哥特式拱门、雕刻石墙和漂浮的尘埃粒子照亮。浓郁的黑、深红、银和深蓝主导色彩基调。

完全为TikTok、ReelShort和DramaBox拍摄。优先使用中近景、特写、极特写、缓慢推近、过肩镜头、戏剧性眼神交流、颤抖的手、细微呼吸和亲密构图。每个镜头都应最大化两位主角之间的情感张力。

场景1（0–5秒）
年轻女子手持古董蜡烛，小心翼翼地走过废弃的城堡走廊。火焰剧烈摇曳，仿佛有什么看不见的东西在注视着她。

女子（低语）：
"我不该来这里……"

一个遥远的男声在黑暗中回荡。

吸血鬼（画外音，低语）：
"……你终于来了。"

场景2（5–10秒）
一具巨大的石棺缓缓打开。吸血鬼贵族安静而优雅地起身，他的深红双眼只盯着她。她恐惧地僵住。

女子：
"你……你是谁？"

吸血鬼（平静地）：
"命运拒绝埋葬的人。"

场景3（10–15秒）
他缓慢靠近，直到两人之间只隔几英寸。他温柔地抬起她的下巴，没有弄疼她，端详着她的脸，仿佛认出了某个早已被遗忘的人。

吸血鬼：
"你的血记得一场世界已经遗忘的战争。"

女子：
"我不知道你在说什么。"

场景4（15–20秒）
她后退一步，尽管害怕却拒绝屈服。他以毫不费力的自信挡住她的退路。

女子：
"我不怕你。"

吸血鬼（柔和微笑）：
"你应该怕。"

场景5（20–25秒）
他靠得更近，双眼与她的目光锁定。他们的呼吸成为唯一的声音。他的表情从好奇转为执念。

吸血鬼：
"我找了你几个世纪……"

女子（几乎低不可闻地）：
"为什么是我？"

吸血鬼：
"因为你属于我的命运。"

场景6（25–30秒）
城堡大门自行猛然关闭。烛火逐一熄灭。他轻轻伸手去握她的手，而她犹豫着，在恐惧与不可抗拒的吸引力之间挣扎。

吸血鬼：
"你可以反抗命运……"

（他缓慢地将手指与她的手指交缠。）

吸血鬼：
"……但你永远逃不出我。"

最终镜头：他们锁定彼此目光的极特写，管弦乐渐强。在他们接吻前硬切至黑屏。

剪辑应具有高端质感且节奏快速，包含电影式硬切、戏剧性推近、优雅慢动作、真实声音设计、管弦乐弦乐、低沉钢琴音符、远处雷声、烛火噼啪声、脚步声、轻柔呼吸、布料摩擦声和细微心跳声。最后一帧以悬念结束，让观众迫切想看第2集。

extra-b441ad6a6b94.zh-Hans: 人设修仙武者：年轻男性，身姿挺拔，气质清冷出尘、仙风道骨；御剑飞行双脚踏着巨剑剑身上，处于战斗施法状态，先后单手结印、双手结印。足下巨剑：宽大厚重，剑身泛寒光，可一分为五，在修仙武者脚下呈扇形展开。巨型妖兽：穷奇外形的庞然巨兽，体型如小山般巨大，四足粗壮、巨爪如柱；处于发狂肆虐状态，四爪先后被锁、挣扎咆哮。场景玄幻仙侠架空世界，一片人迹罕至的荒山野地作为主要空间环境参考，开阔荒原，远处连绵荒山轮廓，偶有碎石与低矮枯木。战斗后期巨兽头顶上空汇聚雷云。画面风格3D CG 高精度建模动画，国漫精品剧集质感；玄幻仙侠题材，写实 CG 建模与毛发皮肤细节，仙术法阵与雷霆特效能量感强烈；宏大战斗场面调度，史诗感。影调开阔荒原大场景、宏大空间纵深；主发光源来自法术能量：巨剑分身寒光、金色法阵明亮金辉自地面向上映照巨兽身型、白紫色雷霆爆裂闪光；雷云汇聚后环境被云层阴影笼罩、明暗对比加剧，法阵金光与雷光交替勾勒妖兽与武者的轮廓；妖兽挣扎时尘土飞扬、暗部细节增多。视觉参考参考国漫《灵笼》《凡人修仙传》CG 剧集视觉质感：高精度角色建模、材质与光影写实、仙术特效的能量流动与光效层次、大场景运镜调度。全局约束无字幕、禁止生成字幕。分镜1，0s-2s，大远景，固定镜头，高机位轻微俯拍，从年轻修仙武者身后拍摄，武者脚踏巨剑剑身御剑悬停在空中位于画面的左上角，镜头视线聚焦下方的荒原野地：一头穷奇外形的巨型妖兽正在荒地上发狂肆虐，挥动巨爪拍碎地面、仰头咆哮，扬起大片尘土碎石；音效：妖兽低沉咆哮、爪击地面的闷响、碎石飞溅声。分镜2，2s-4s，中近景，固定镜头，聚焦悬停空中的武者上半身近景，武者目光一凝，随即抬手单手结印，口唇快速念出咒语「分则能成！」；音效：低沉咒语吟诵声。分镜3，4s-5s，切换武者脚下巨剑特写，固定镜头，脚下的巨剑剑身泛起光纹、嗡鸣震动，随即一分为五，在修仙武者脚下呈扇形展开，巨剑本体仍位于武者脚下；音效：剑身震颤金属嗡鸣。分镜4，5s-8s，大远景→妖兽四只巨爪的局部中景，荷兰角，快速跟拍，镜头紧密跟随四把分身巨剑的飞射轨迹跟拍。四把分身巨剑如流光般疾速飞射而下，分别命中妖兽四只巨爪，击中瞬间化作虚灵形态的灵光锁链缠绕锁紧四爪；妖兽四爪被锁、挣扎甩动却无法挣脱，仰头怒吼；音效：剑气破空声、锁链缠绕铮鸣、妖兽挣扎怒吼、地面震颤闷响。分镜5，8s-10s，特写，固定镜头，聚焦武者胸前结印的双手。高空中的武者双手抬起、十指交叠快速多次结印，法力凝聚的微光在掌间亮起，随即放声暴喝；对白：修仙武者（怒喝）：「雷光咒！」；音效：灵力汇聚的低沉嗡鸣、武者暴喝声、妖兽持续咆哮。分镜6，10s-11s，全景，仰拍后拉。妖兽脚下的地面骤然亮起一个与它身型投影同样巨大的金色法阵，符文旋转展开、金光上涌，将挣扎的妖兽笼罩其中；音效：法阵启动的深沉轰鸣、能量流动的嗡嗡声。分镜7，11s-15s，大远景，仰拍。妖兽头顶上空乌云迅速汇聚，雷云翻滚、电光在云层中窜动，天色骤然压暗；一道巨大白紫色雷霆从乌云中迸发，自天而降击中巨兽身体，法阵金光与雷光同时爆发，妖兽身形被耀眼光芒吞没、剧烈震颤；音效：雷云翻滚闷响、电流滋啦声、雷霆炸裂巨响、轰鸣回响、大地震动。全局配乐：纯音乐 + 无词吟唱0s-2s：琵琶轮指 + 二胡紧张颤音长音，低音提琴拨弦脉冲；旋律短促、小二度游移（不安定感），音量中等、密度低2s-4s：琵琶扫弦 + 古筝十六分音符急奏，堂鼓+小钹进入密集节奏层，弦乐群齐奏推高4s-5s：大鼓滚奏渐密，铜管短促强音（"锁"的动作感），低频持续音垫底；妖兽咆哮处配乐主动让位——音量降、减旋律密度，给咆哮音效留空间5s-8s：只留低频持续音 + 箫孤音。打击乐静默、旋律消失8s-10s：古筝泛音 + 弦乐长音渐强，无词女声"啊——"进入（非歌词）；和声从暗小调切向明亮大三和弦的临时离调10s-11s：大鼓滚奏 + 定音鼓渐强，弦乐密集颤音，30-60Hz 低频持续轰鸣；旋律线消失，只剩节奏与和声爬升；11s-15s：大鼓+定音鼓+镲片同击，唢呐/铜管齐奏强音，琵琶古筝最高密度扫弦；雷光爆闪处配乐让位 0.3s 给雷声音效；结尾快速衰减至低频余震 + 箫尾音
extra-b441ad6a6b94.en: Character design: a cultivator martial artist: young male, upright posture, with a cool, aloof, otherworldly air and an immortal, Daoist bearing; flying on a sword with both feet on the blade of a giant sword, in a combat spellcasting state, first forming hand seals with one hand, then with both hands. The giant sword beneath his feet: broad and heavy, its blade gleaming with cold light, able to split into five, spreading out in a fan shape beneath the cultivator martial artist's feet. Giant beast: a colossal beast in the form of a Qiongqi, its body as huge as a small mountain, with thick, sturdy four legs and giant claws like pillars; in a state of frenzied rampage, its four claws are locked in succession, and it struggles and roars. The scene is a xuanhuan xianxia fictional world, with a remote, uninhabited wild mountain wilderness as the main spatial environment reference, an open wasteland, the silhouettes of continuous barren mountains in the distance, and occasional broken stones and low dead trees. In the later stage of the battle, thunderclouds gather above the giant beast's head. Visual style: 3D CG high-precision modeling animation, the quality of a premium Chinese animation series; xuanhuan xianxia subject matter, realistic CG modeling and hair and skin detail, immortal arts magic circles and thunder special effects with a strong sense of energy; grand battle scene staging, with an epic feel. Tonal rendering: open wasteland large scene, grand spatial depth; the main light sources come from spell energy: the cold light of the giant sword's clones, the bright golden radiance of the golden magic circle shining upward from the ground onto the giant beast's body, the bursting flashes of white-purple thunder; after the thunderclouds gather, the environment is shrouded in cloud shadows, and the light-dark contrast intensifies, with the golden light of the magic circle and the thunder light alternately outlining the silhouettes of the giant beast and the martial artist; when the giant beast struggles, dust flies up and dark-area detail increases. Visual reference: refer to the visual quality of the CG series of the Chinese animations "Ling Cage" (《灵笼》) and "A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality" (《凡人修仙传》): high-precision character modeling, realistic materials and lighting, the energy flow and light-effect layers of immortal arts special effects, and large-scene camera staging. Global constraints: no subtitles, subtitle generation prohibited. Shot 1, 0s-2s, extreme long shot, fixed camera, high angle with a slight downward tilt, shot from behind the young cultivator martial artist, the martial artist stands with his feet on the giant sword's blade, hovering in the air on the sword in the upper left corner of the frame, the camera's line of sight focuses on the wasteland below: a giant beast in the form of a Qiongqi is rampaging across the wasteland, swinging its giant claws to smash the ground, raising its head and roaring, kicking up a large amount of dust and broken stones; sound effects: the giant beast's low roars, the muffled thuds of claws striking the ground, the sound of flying gravel. Shot 2, 2s-4s, medium close-up, fixed camera, focusing on a close-up of the upper body of the martial artist hovering in the air, the martial artist's gaze sharpens, then he raises his hand and forms a hand seal with one hand, his lips quickly recite the incantation "分则能成！" ("Divide, and they shall become!") ; sound effects: low incantation chanting. Shot 3, 4s-5s, cut to a close-up of the giant sword beneath the martial artist's feet, fixed camera, the blade of the giant sword beneath his feet lights up with glowing patterns, hums and vibrates, then splits into five, spreading out in a fan shape beneath the cultivator martial artist's feet, with the main body of the giant sword still beneath the martial artist's feet; sound effects: blade trembling, metallic humming. Shot 4, 5s-8s, extreme long shot → medium shot of the local area of the giant beast's four giant claws, Dutch angle, rapid tracking shot, the camera closely follows the flight trajectories of the four clone giant swords. The four clone giant swords shoot down rapidly like streaks of light, each striking one of the giant beast's four giant claws; at the moment of impact they transform into spirit-light chains in ethereal form that wrap around and lock the four claws tightly; the giant beast's four claws are locked, and it struggles and swings them but cannot break free, raising its head and roaring in fury; sound effects: sword qi tearing through the air, the clanging of chains wrapping, the giant beast's struggling roars, the muffled rumbling of the ground shaking. Shot 5, 8s-10s, close-up, fixed camera, focusing on the martial artist's hands forming seals in front of his chest. The martial artist high in the air raises both hands, interlocks his ten fingers and rapidly forms seals multiple times, a faint glimmer of condensed mana lights up between his palms, then he lets out a loud shout; dialogue: cultivator martial artist (angry shout): "雷光咒！" ("Thunder Light Curse!") ; sound effects: the low humming of spiritual power gathering, the martial artist's loud shout, the giant beast's continuous roaring. Shot 6, 10s-11s, full shot, low-angle shot then pull back. The ground beneath the giant beast's feet suddenly lights up with a golden magic circle as huge as the projection of its body, the runes rotate and unfold, golden light surges upward, enveloping the struggling giant beast within it; sound effects: the deep rumbling of the magic circle activating, the buzzing of energy flow. Shot 7, 11s-15s, extreme long shot, low-angle shot. Dark clouds rapidly gather above the giant beast's head, the thunderclouds churn, electric light darts through the cloud layers, and the sky suddenly darkens; a huge white-purple thunderbolt bursts from the dark clouds, strikes down from the sky onto the giant beast's body, the golden light of the magic circle and the thunder light erupt simultaneously, the giant beast's form is swallowed by the dazzling light and trembles violently; sound effects: the muffled rumbling of churning thunderclouds, the crackling of electric current, the deafening crash of thunder, rumbling reverberations, the earth shaking. Global soundtrack: pure instrumental music + wordless chanting 0s-2s: pipa tremolo + erhu tense tremolo long tones, double bass pizzicato pulses; the melody is short and brisk, wandering in minor seconds (a sense of instability), medium volume, low density 2s-4s: pipa strumming + guzheng rapid sixteenth-note runs, tanggu + small cymbals enter as a dense rhythmic layer, the string section plays in unison to build up 4s-5s: grand drum rolls growing denser, short, forceful brass accents (the sense of the "locking" action), a sustained low-frequency drone underneath; at the giant beast's roar the music actively yields—volume drops, melodic density decreases, leaving space for the roar sound effect 5s-8s: only a sustained low-frequency drone + a lone xiao note. Percussion falls silent, melody disappears 8s-10s: guzheng harmonics + string long tones gradually crescendo, a wordless female voice "Ah—" enters (not lyrics); the harmony temporarily modulates from a dark minor key to a bright major triad 10s-11s: grand drum rolls + timpani crescendo, dense string tremolo, a sustained 30-60Hz low-frequency rumble; the melodic line disappears, leaving only rhythm and harmony climbing; 11s-15s: grand drum + timpani + cymbals strike together, suona/brass play in unison with forceful accents, pipa and guzheng strum at their highest density; at the thunder-light flash the music yields for 0.3s to the thunder sound effect; the ending rapidly decays to a low-frequency aftershock + a final xiao note

extra-174d99e61d8e.zh-Hans:
创作一段单一连续的自拍vlog，使用手持运动相机以16:9画幅拍摄。摄影机始终由拟人化狐狸手持，形成自然的第一人称自拍视角，带有轻微风引起的晃动、偶尔因阳光透过树木而产生的柔和镜头光晕、真实的焦点切换，以及动态的行走/倾斜运动。无剪辑、无转场、无电影特效。在右下角加入一个细微的真实数字时间戳，在视频中自然推进。
视觉风格：明亮的现代4K数字观感，色彩鲜艳但柔和自然，温暖的午后金色阳光与斑驳树荫交织，轻柔的水面反光与溪流升起的薄雾，靠近水面时镜头上有细微水珠或雾气，毛发与树叶细节清晰。略带手持感但足够平稳，适合随意vlog。宽屏16:9构图。
角色：Ember，一只24岁的拟人化红狐（双足行走，类人比例），拥有柔软蓬松的红橙色毛发、白色胸脯与口鼻、明亮的琥珀色眼睛、尖耳朵，以及一条自然摆动的长而蓬松的尾巴。他穿着一件简单的浅色牛仔夹克，袖子卷起，内搭柔软奶油色T恤和舒适的工装短裤。性格：好奇、温暖、略带俏皮且说话轻柔。
地点：从一座横跨清澈山溪的木制人行桥开始，周围是茂密的温带森林，遍布长满苔藓的岩石、蕨类、野花和悬垂的枫树与松树枝。柔和的绿色与金色枝叶，清澈水面泛着轻柔涟漪，小鱼在下方穿梭。
序列（恰好30秒，连续长镜头并带时间戳）：
0:00 – 0:05
Ember举起相机，对着镜头温柔微笑，耳朵竖起，用温暖、略带沙哑的声音说：
"嘿朋友们……你们不会相信我找到的这个地方。"
0:05 – 0:13
他沿着木桥缓慢行走，稍微放低相机，展示清澈的溪流和水面下游动的小鱼，同时继续说：
"水太清了……我能看见每一条小鱼在动。"
0:13 – 0:20
他在边缘小心蹲下，伸出一只爪子靠近水面但不触碰，看着鱼群掠过，轻声笑道：
"它们正游到我面前。嗨，小家伙们。"
0:20 – 0:26
他转动相机，同时拍下自己的脸和溪流，然后坐在水边一块平坦的长满苔藓的岩石上，让尾巴蜷在身旁。他凝视水面几秒钟，轻声说：
"这样的时刻让一切都感觉很平静。"
0:26 – 0:30
他站起身，带着温柔微笑向相机挥动一只爪子，说：
"谢谢你和我一起探索。下次见。"
当他沿着溪边小路继续往前走时，相机自然稍微降低。

extra-456e261d5a05.zh-Hans:
核心主题
大学操场，一镜到底打斗场景。两名格斗者，徒手搏击，包含真实特技与踢击。战斗以女孩的火焰力量觉醒告终。她以一记决定性的最后一击终结他。连续镜头，无剪辑，无编辑。16:9 画幅比例。

角色外观锁定

格斗者 A（男孩）
